_comment: Staged replica (fixtures/ats/_staged/server.ts): same FormSpec as a manifest.json, kept out of the e2e until its job's Claude requests are recorded. Rename to manifest.json to promote (and port the /__account endpoints to a fixture-routes module).

forms.title: SAP SuccessFactors candidate site: Apply now, data privacy consent, sign in / Create an Account, one-page application
quirks: one client-rendered document: job listing → 'Apply now' → Data Privacy Consent Statement dialog (Accept / Decline) → login wall → application

form#loginForm (Email, Password, Sign In) and 'Create an Account' → form#createAccountForm with fbclc_* ids: Email, Retype Email, Choose Password, Retype Password, First Name, Last Name, Country/Region of Residence, a job-alerts opt-in that must stay unticked
'An account with this email already exists' when the email is taken; the session lasts for the browser session
application name and email prefilled from the account; Country/Region is an SF combobox (input role=combobox + listbox) whose value lives in a hidden input
'Upload a Resume' button over a hidden file input next to 'Paste resume'; optional cover letter text
'No Selection' placeholder options, a radio question, EEO selects with 'Prefer not to say'
'Save Draft' / 'Cancel' next to the final 'Apply' button; field-level .sfError role=alert
forms.reference: Public SuccessFactors candidate sites (career<N>.successfactors.com/career?company=…&career_job_req_id=…), studied read-only
